profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary:
I'm a Lead Software Engineer who has spent six years building web applications end to end, from React frontends to the APIs behind them. For the past four years I've been at Booz Allen Hamilton working on Recreation.gov, the platform people use to discover and book campsites, permits, and tours across national parks and federal lands. Before that, I spent two years at Vanguard building the Java and Spring APIs supporting their investment platform. I hold a BS in Data Science with a CS minor from Drexel University and an MBA from the University of Maryland.

Currently interested in opportunities in frontend development or full-stack roles with a frontend tilt. Open to relocating.

positions.title: Software Engineer, 3 (Lead) - Fullstack (Frontend Focused)
positions.description: Skills: JavaScript · Redux · TypeScript · Agile Methodologies · LaunchDarkly · Go (Programming Language) · Github Actions · SCSS · Argo CD · React.js

positions.title: Software Engineer, 2 (Staff) - Frontend
positions.description:
» Developed frontend portion using React and Redux of external facing web application and administrative app. Recreation.gov is an e-commerce site that allows to plan trips across the United States including federally managed parks, forests, monuments and waterways. 
» Worked with a mix of functional and class components.  Enhanced & created new features, fixed bugs in application, performed unit and integration testing using React Testing Library, deployed app using ArgoCD.  Handle service calls from Go APIs using Axios and Redux.  Handle rollouts using LaunchDarkly flags.  Implemented and updated features using Figma mockups from the design team.  
» Styled components using SCSS

Project: Recreation.gov

Groups: 
Camping 07/2022-08/2023 
Permits 08/2023-04/2026, Activity Pass/Tree Permits (Additional areas added to permits load) 08/2025 - 04/2026 
Access Management (Site Passes, America The Beautiful Passes, Tickets, Timed Entry) 04/2026

positions.title: Software Developer II-Backend
positions.description: Refer to Software Dev I description below

positions.title: Software Developer I-Backend
positions.description:
» Developed Java Spring web services (REST) that power the Vanguard mobile and web customer-facing investment platform.
» Worked with team to migrate web services from Pivotal Cloud Foundry to Amazon (AWS) ECS.
» Performed unit and integration testing using the Junit, Mockito, and Cucumber frameworks.
» Provided developer support for consumers of our web services. Analyzed web service logs using Splunk and Honeycomb.
» Worked in a DevOps environment developing, deploying, supporting and troubleshooting our web-services in a production environment.
» Department: IT/Retail, Subdivision: Retail Trading Solutions reorg to Retail APIs, Group: Balances and Funds Available

positions.title: Data Science Programming I  (INFO 212) Course Assistant
positions.description:
» Served as a Teaching Assistant working with students on learning Python and libraries for data analysis (Numpy, Pandas, Matplotlib)
» Graded assignments and provided feedback.

company.name: Drexel University College of Computing & Informatics

positions.title: Data Science Co-op (6 month internship)
positions.description:
» Developed a machine learning model to predict customer churn.
» Used the Microsoft R package MicrosoftML to construct fast forest, decision trees, decision forests, and logistic regression models.
» Preprocessed and transformed healthcare data using Python and R.
» Developed tools in Python for streamlining ETL processes within my team.
» Presented at a machine learning workshop on a bi-weekly basis  
» Developed data visualizations using Tableau.
Department: IT, Team: Analytics, Strategy & Architecture

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern - Fullstack
positions.description:
» Developed and enhanced a web-based system used to manage operational IP video delivery infrastructure. 
» Backend development using Ruby on Rails (ERB & Ruby) with MySQL.
» Participated in Comcast’s Agile software development processes and lifecycle.
» Recommendations below in section
Department: T&P (Technology and Product), Team: VBO-Eng: Video-On-Demand back office application development and integration

honors.title: Contributor Spotlight Award - Demonstrating Collective Ingenuity
honors.description:
Earned this award for technical contributions to Booz Allen by contributing to React & Angular code scaffolds. 
Collective Ingenuity: Be resourceful and creative, seek to make the biggest difference in every problem you solve. Be devoted to the team and harness the power of diversity.

honors.title: Vanguard Spot Award
honors.description: Spot Awards are used to celebrate deserving crew members who have gone above and beyond in their day-to-day and project-related responsibilities. Earned this award for technical contributions to Vanguard.

volunteerExperiences.description:
» Planned and moderated 30+ events including tech talks, panels, and social events.  
» Helped bring in more than $2000 in sponsorship 
» Built relationships with members and managed other officers
» Applied for conference funding and registered WiCS members for the ACM Capital Region Celebration of Women in Computing (CAPWIC) 2020 conference.  Later cancelled due to COVID.

» Kept records of all transactions/deposits in accounts, managed the budget, reported the financial situation to other officers. Put in purchase requests for items to be purchased out of accounts.
» Applied for funding through various sources via fundraisers and grants. Applied for conference funding and registered WiCS members for the ACM Philadelphia Region Celebration of Women in Computing (PHICWIC) 2018 conference and also for the ACM CAPWIC 2019 conference.
» Led a fundraising committee of five WiCS members who assisted in compiling corporate sponsorship contacts and also helped with pr for fundraisers.  We brought in more than $200 from fundraisers.
